RAJYA   SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the April 18, 2002/Chaitra 28, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; External Affairs; Labour; Parliamentary
Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning;
Road Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries;
Space; Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total Number of questions—20
110
Telephone connections to senior
citizens
*361. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether senior citizens are
provided telephone connections on
priority basis;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of applications received
by Government from senior citizens for
new telephone connections during
January, 2002, in Gaya, Bihar, in general
and Delha Mohalla in particular; and
(d) by when these applications would
be cleared and installation of telephones
completed?
Cable theft in Mainpuri
†*362. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
Will the Minister of COMMU-
NICATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that incidents
of cable theft have increased in district
Mainpuri, U.P. during the last two years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the measures contemplated to deal
with the problem;
(d) whether it is also a fact that
complaints have been received to the
effect that telephones remained out of
order for quite a long time during this
period; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and efforts
made to rectify the same?
Foodgrains Management Policy
*363. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's attention
has been drawn to the news-report,
captioned, "Foodgrains Management
Policy in limbo" appearing in the Hindu
dated the 8th March, 2002;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

111
WIN2\SESSION\111RS-QUES 111
(b) if so, by when a firm Foodgrains
Management Policy is likely to be put in
place; and
(c) whether the opinion of the various
State Governments with regard to the
Foodgrains Management Policy is likely
to be solicited before finalising the same
and if not, the reasons therefor?
Over charging by PCOs
†*364. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that PCOs in
the country are charging at old rates even
now;
(b) if so, whether Government are
going to take any steps to check this; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Transit of foodgrains
†*365. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the agriculture experts
have demanded Government for
immediate repeal of the Essential
Commodities Act, with a view to
providing for unhindered transit of
foodgrains in the country;
(b) whether such demands had also
been made previously;
(c) if so, what are the reasons for not
repealing the same; and
(d) the action taken by Government on
the demands raised by the experts?
Graduate Level Main Examination,
1999 by SSC
*366. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the final results of the
Combined Graduate Level Main
Examination, 1999, were declared by the
Staff Selection Commission in the last
week of January, 2002;
(b) if so, whether dossiers of the
successful candidates for the posts of
Income Tax Inspector and Assistant are
yet to be forwarded to the concerned
Departments;
(c) if so, the reasons for delay in
forwarding the dossiers; and
(d) by when the dossiers would be sent
to the concerned departments so that they
could issue the offers of appointment to
the successful candidates?
Use of rubber bitumen in
constructing roads
*367.SHRI C.O. POULOSE:
SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any study has been
conducted on the viability of using rubber
bitumen in constructing roads;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government of Kerala has
sent any request to the Union Government
seeking use of rubber bitumen in the
construction of National Highways and
other roads; and
(d) if so, the details thereof along with
the action taken by Government thereon?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

WIN2\SESSION\111RS-QUES 112
Rise in buffer stock of foodgrains
*368.SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the buffer stock of
foodgrains by the end of this year is
estimated to rise from the existing 580
lakh tonnes to more than 675 lakh tonnes;
(b) if so, what steps Government have
taken or propose to take to tackle this
problem; and
(c) whether Government would
consider to revamp the Public Distribution
System (PDS) and if so, the details
thereof?
Lifting of control over foodgrains
*369. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to free foodgrains from its
control;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when Government are going to
introduce the Warehousing Receipt Act
which would enable the farmers to go to
a private owner of a warehouse for better
price of their produce; and
(d) what are the salient features of the
proposed policy?
Closing down of PCO/STD booths in
J&K
*370. MIRZA ABDUL RASHID: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of PCO and STD
booths closed down in Jammu and
Kashmir due to acute militancy, recently,
district-wise;
(b) how many employees have been
rendered jobless and income-less in the
State, district-wise;
(c) what steps the Central and State
Governments propose to take for
rehabilitating such jobless youths in the
State where lacs of educated youth have
been facing unemployment; and
(d) by when such PCO/STD booths
would be revived?
Integrated Test Facilities
*371. SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE: Will the Minister of
LABOUR be pleased to state:
(a) whether Integrated Test Facilities
(ITF) of Jessop and Company Ltd. is being
treated as National Test House for testing
of Underground Mining Roof Supports for
use in the Indian mines;
(b) if so, whether the same purpose can
be served after the proposed privatisation/
disinvestment of Jessop and Company
Ltd.; and
(c) if not, the action taken by
Government to maintain the present status
of ITF?
Carry forward of unused telephone
calls
*372. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of COMMU-
NICATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
carry forward unused telephone calls to
next quarter of the year; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?

113
WIN2\SESSION\111RS-QUES 113
Allocation of shops and PDS dealership
to SCs/STs in tribal areas
*373.SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the action taken to allocate shops
and PDS dealership in tribal areas to
SC/ST categories only; and
(b) the action taken to sanction loan
to the allottees from the National
Scheduled Caste Financial Development
Corporation (N.S.F.D.C.) with sale
guarantee?
Employment growth
*374. SHRIMATI SARLA
MAHESHWARI: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the rate of employment growth in
the country during the period 1987—1994
and 1994—2001, period-wise, separately;
(b) whether it is a fact that the rate of
employment growth is dwindling; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor?
I.T. in Northern States
*375. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMU-
NICATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Northern
States are far behind the Southern States
in the field of Information Technology;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) what steps are being taken by
Government to remove this regional
imbalance; and
(d) in what manner Government plan
to promote Information Technology in the
Northern States?
Declaration of National Highways in
Karnataka
*376. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Highways, indicating
their length, declared as National
Highways, so far, since 1998-99, in
various States;
(b) whether Government of Karnataka
has requested his Ministry to declare
approximately 1100 Kilometre of roads
as National Highways; and
(c) if so, the details of the projects and
the action taken by his Ministry in this
regard?
Lowering of telephone charges
*377. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMU-
NICATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether telephone is essential for
lower middle class and retired employees;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to increase the number of free calls and
reduce the rental charges to help the poor
subscriber; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

WIN2\SESSION\111RS-QUES 114
Upgradation of PCO Centres
*378. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the All India PCO
Franchises Association has appealed to
Government to upgrade PCO Centres to
'Multiple Internet Services Centres’ to
generate revenue for PCOs; and
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to accede to this request?
Nepalese Prime Minister's visit to
India
*379. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the discussions that
took place with the Nepalese Prime
Minister during his recent five day official
visit to India;
(b) whether issues like increasing
security on the border, removing trade
barriers recently imposed by India, were
discussed;
(c) if so, the outcome thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
E-bill facility
*380. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) what are the salient features of
E-bill facility operated by Post Offices;
(b) whether Government are going to
establish E-bill post service centres in
various parts of Maharashtra; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
